controlsRationale: Auto external panel exposes original palette and brush tools. G enters drawing, P/R/B select pencil/rectangle/fill, K undo, M invert, L grayscale, UP/DOWN brush radius, ESC returns/exits. Relative drag holds original left button; no direct touch/calibration or source art changes.

nativeGameplay.demonstrated: ROOT visually reviewed native controls, actual gameplay checkpoints and browser portrait controls and canonical real gameplay frames. Ordinary native touch Draw opens the original canvas; two real drags draw a continuous black stroke, Rectangle commits a solid black shape on release, inversion/grayscale retains the drawing and palette, and Escape returns to the original menu before Home.
limitations: Representative local drawing tools qualified. Linked drawing is not claimed.
